classes.name: Markdown Document Content
classes.handling: Keep document content local in editor state and write it only through native save operations.

classes.name: Local File Path
classes.handling: Obtain paths through native dialogs and display only document filenames in the frontend rail/title where possible.

classes.name: Dirty State
classes.handling: Track locally in frontend and Go state to prevent accidental data loss.

classes.name: Editor Mode and View Preferences
classes.handling: Persist user-selected runtime settings through the native preference store and apply them on frontend boot.

classes.name: Application Preferences
classes.handling: Store editor settings and raw view options as local JSON under the user's config directory.

classes.name: Recent Document Entry
classes.handling: Store local document paths in the native preference store for start-screen recents; use paths only for local reopen actions.

classes.name: Installed Font Family
classes.handling: Read local installed font family names through the native app boundary and use them only to populate runtime settings controls.
